VD-AUTOHEAT.Policy: Deterministic unit checks first; trace/log assertions protect event order; physical head-unit smoke remains required for native and lifecycle behavior.

V-M-PLUGIN.Scenario: getHvacIntProperty and event callbacks preserve the MethodChannel/EventChannel contract.
connect, get, and set native failures propagate as platform errors instead of false success.
V-M-PLUGIN.TraceAssertion: Manual head-unit smoke must confirm HVAC permission, connection, read/write, and callback behavior. Native plugin evidence is collected through MethodChannel/EventChannel callbacks; it does not emit the app Logger marker format.

V-M-ENUMS.Scenario: Every HeatMode and UserType name round-trips through its fromString extension.
Unknown and case-mismatched strings use the documented safe fallback.
Snapshot names remain manual, presets, auto and driver, passenger.
V-M-ENUMS.TraceAssertion: Changing enum names requires a SharedPreferences migration before merge.

V-M-LOGGER.Scenario: All four log levels emit deterministic [Module][function][BLOCK] lines and preserve field order.
rawCarPropertyValue is redacted outside debug level and test sinks restore the default sink.
V-M-LOGGER.TraceAssertion: Logger must not introduce package:logger, package:logging, or debugPrint dependencies.

V-M-CONSTANTS-TEMPERATURE.Scenario: Temperature boundaries map to off, warm, cool, cold, freezing, and extreme exactly as documented.
HeatSequence returns null for off and the expected durations for warm through extreme ranges.
V-M-CONSTANTS-TEMPERATURE.TraceAssertion: Duration sums remain aligned with AutoHeatService timer trajectories.

V-M-HVAC.Scenario: Seat writes connect once, preserve outgoing call order, and propagate write failures.
Inside temperature events convert raw 84/74/124 to 0/-5/20 Celsius and ignore wrong property or area.
Multiple listeners, initial reads, string values, null events, and raw -1 sentinels follow the cached-value contract.
V-M-HVAC.TraceAssertion: Logger output must preserve [HvacService][initialize][BLOCK_INITIALIZE], [HvacService][setSeatHeatLevel][BLOCK_SET_SEAT_HEAT_LEVEL], [HvacService][onHvacChangeEvent][BLOCK_HANDLE_TEMPERATURE_EVENT], and [HvacService][getCabinTemperature][BLOCK_GET_CABIN_TEMPERATURE]; test/unit/hvac_service_test.dart asserts the assembled lines.

V-M-AUTO-HEAT.Scenario: FakeAsync verifies cold, warm, and extreme sequences as callback levels 3, 2, 1, 0.
Temperature changes cancel or retain timers according to effective plan identity and do not spam repeated levels.
Driver and passenger timers remain independent; stopAutoHeat prevents later callbacks.
ManualHeatSettings thresholds and durations override fallback constants without changing mode semantics.
V-M-AUTO-HEAT.TraceAssertion: startAutoHeat must initialize the sequence, while Logger output must preserve [AutoHeatService][stepDownLevel][BLOCK_STEP_DOWN] and [AutoHeatService][scheduleMaxTimer][BLOCK_SCHEDULE_MAX_TIMER]. Every timer transition must match the HeatSequence from M-CONSTANTS-TEMPERATURE; test/unit/auto_heat_service_test.dart asserts the assembled lines.

V-M-MODE.Scenario: Cold start defaults both users to manual level zero without HVAC writes.
setMode, setHeatLevel, applyPreset, toggleHeatLevel, and automatic callbacks synchronize persistence, HVAC, and state.
Automatic and presets modes remain decoupled; selected preset settings are restored safely on cold start.
V-M-MODE.TraceAssertion: Logger output must preserve [ModeCubit][setMode][BLOCK_SET_MODE], [ModeCubit][setHeatLevel][BLOCK_SET_HEAT_LEVEL], and [ModeCubit][applyPreset][BLOCK_APPLY_PRESET]. Manual transition stops automatic scheduling before applying the new level; tests assert the assembled lines.

V-M-CABIN-TEMPERATURE.Scenario: Initial and cached temperature reads populate state without an unnecessary second native read.
HVAC events update state and closing the Cubit removes its listener.
CabinTemperatureDisplay renders initial and updated Celsius values.
V-M-CABIN-TEMPERATURE.TraceAssertion: Temperature-only updates never change a seat-heating level.

V-M-PRESET.Scenario: Preset save, load, delete, malformed JSON fallback, and legacy JSON compatibility are deterministic.
Selected preset IDs persist independently for driver and passenger and clear on deletion.
Applying a preset updates runtime mode and HVAC through ModeCubit.
V-M-PRESET.TraceAssertion: Preset persistence must not overwrite the other user's selected preset.

V-M-SETTINGS.Scenario: Default threshold and persistence behavior remain stable; the settings UI exposes the expected controls.
V-M-SETTINGS.TraceAssertion: The test block START_BLOCK_HEAD_UNIT_SMOKE in test/widget/settings_screen_test.dart verifies the SettingsScreen head-unit layout. Missing legacy settings_service_test is retained as a planned coverage gap rather than a fabricated test file.

V-M-THEME.Scenario: Theme colors interpolate field-wise without base or green fallback.
Persisted theme initialization and selection are covered by the UI path when the dedicated Cubit test is added.
V-M-THEME.TraceAssertion: The test block START_BLOCK_THEME_COLOR_LERP in test/unit/theme_colors_test.dart verifies field-wise lerp behavior; this is a test semantic block, not a runtime log marker.

V-M-DI.Scenario: setupServiceLocator registers all required singletons and Cubits.
Repeated setup is idempotent and preserves existing singleton instances.
V-M-DI.TraceAssertion: UI and background onStart bootstrap paths must remain synchronized per isolate.

V-M-BLOC-PROVIDERS.Scenario: Root provider composition exposes all Cubits required by AppContent and its child screens.
V-M-BLOC-PROVIDERS.TraceAssertion: Dedicated app_bloc_providers_test remains a planned gap; current AppContent coverage is the available executable evidence.

V-M-BACKGROUND.Command: Manual head-unit smoke: foreground notification, ignition ON/OFF, stopService, and restart backoff.
V-M-BACKGROUND.Scenario: BackgroundRuntimeController awaits both seat shutdowns before stopSelf on command or ignition OFF.
Malformed ignition and startup failures are logged; bounded backoff stops at max attempts.
V-M-BACKGROUND.TraceAssertion: Logger output must preserve [BackgroundService][onStart][BLOCK_ON_START], [BackgroundService][onStart][BLOCK_RESTART_BACKOFF], and [BackgroundService][handleIgnition][BLOCK_HANDLE_IGNITION]. The linked runtime uses the structured Logger API and the test asserts the assembled lines; restart backoff is owned by handleStartFailure.

V-M-ACCESSIBILITY.Command: Manual head-unit smoke: accessibility callback wakes the foreground service.
V-M-ACCESSIBILITY.Scenario: setCallbackHandle registers a valid entry point and system wake-up starts the service when needed.
V-M-ACCESSIBILITY.TraceAssertion: Accessibility wake must use the HvacService-owned plugin instance and must not create a second plugin handler.

V-M-MAIN.Scenario: AutoheatApp mounts AppContent and disables theme transition animation.
Release manifest preserves the package permission envelope and accessibility service declaration.
V-M-MAIN.TraceAssertion: The test block START_BLOCK_AUTOHEAT_APP_THEME_TRANSITION in test/widget/app_smoke_test.dart verifies AutoheatApp theme transition behavior. Cold-start and release APK behavior require final validation on the target head unit and CI workflow.

V-M-UI-APP.Scenario: Navigation between Heat, Presets, and Settings tabs preserves the intended shell order.
V-M-UI-APP.TraceAssertion: Applying a preset from the app shell delegates runtime application to ModeCubit.

V-M-UI-HEAT.Scenario: Seat-level interaction routes to ModeCubit and cabin-temperature display follows the Cubit listener.
V-M-UI-HEAT.TraceAssertion: Heat screen smoke must cover driver/passenger, manual/auto/presets, and levels 0 through 3.

V-M-UI-PRESETS.Scenario: PresetsTab composes the user selector, editor, and list; apply/edit/delete semantics are preserved.
Dirty draft application, silent active-preset switch, empty state, and white-theme contrast follow the UX contract.
V-M-UI-PRESETS.TraceAssertion: Dedicated presets_tab_test remains a planned gap; current contrast and app-shell tests are retained as executable evidence.

V-M-UI-SETTINGS.Scenario: Theme selection, cabin-temperature visibility, bounded layout, and white-theme foreground contrast remain correct.
V-M-UI-SETTINGS.TraceAssertion: The test block START_BLOCK_HEAD_UNIT_SMOKE in test/widget/settings_screen_test.dart verifies the SettingsScreen layout. Settings controls must remain visible above the fold on the target 1920x720 head-unit viewport.
